claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Credo 後續 10-K／10-Q／法說寫出 LRO 用 DSP 停產、不再推出下一代，或寫明 LRO 版本沒有量產客戶；或模組廠、雲端業者的一手寫出 LRO 用 DSP 的主要供應者是別家而非 Credo。核查頻率：每季（Credo 10-Q 與法說）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 依新文件降 confidence 或提撤回；重讀 LRO 層讀圖的供給側。
claims.statement: Credo's FY2026 10-K (fiscal year ended 2026-05-02): each of its three 100G/lane optical DSP generations (Dove, Lark, Robin) 'also offers a unidirectional 8×100G variant designed for Linear Receive Optics (LRO), an architecture pioneered by Credo that removes DSP functionality from the module receiver', and its 200G/lane Bluebird DSP is designed for 'full‑retimed and LRO‑based 1.6 Tb/s transceivers'. Issuer self-report in a statutory filing (L8 weak; 'pioneered by Credo' is a self-claim, sole_source not asserted); no LRO shipment volume, revenue share or customer is given.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Credo 後續 10-K／10-Q 寫出退出或出售光 DSP 產品線，或光 DSP 不再列為產品；或模組廠一手寫出某一代主流光模組 DSP 的供應商不含 Credo。核查頻率：每季（Credo 10-Q 與法說）。觸發後 48 小時：e2 降 confidence 或提撤回；重讀光模組 DSP 層（tech:optical_module_dsp）的供給側。
claims.statement: Credo's FY2026 10-K: Credo optical DSPs 'are core components within optical transceivers deployed in AI clusters, hyperscale data centers, service‑provider networks, enterprise networks, and 5G wireless infrastructure', now in their seventh generation at 50G/lane, 100G/lane and 200G/lane PAM4. Issuer self-report in a statutory filing; this section names no module-maker customer, unit volume or share.

sources.locator: Item 1. Business — Optical DSPs 第一段（10-K 頁碼 11）
sources.quote: Credo optical digital signal processors (DSPs) are core components within optical transceivers deployed in AI clusters, hyperscale data centers, service‑provider networks, enterprise networks, and 5G wireless infrastructure.

sources.locator: Item 1. Business — Optical DSPs 第二段
sources.quote: Now in their seventh generation, Credo DSPs operating at 50G/lane, 100G/lane and 200G/lane PAM4 signaling combine high performance, low latency, power efficiency, and high reliability.

sources.locator: Item 1. Business — Optical DSPs，Dove／Lark／Robin 段首句
sources.quote: The Credo Dove, Lark, and Robin families operate at 100G/lane across three successive technology generations.

sources.locator: Item 1. Business — Optical DSPs，Dove／Lark／Robin 段末句
sources.quote: Each generation also offers a unidirectional 8×100G variant designed for Linear Receive Optics (LRO), an architecture pioneered by Credo that removes DSP functionality from the module receiver to improve energy efficiency in large‑scale AI deployments.
Bluebird is designed to enable a new generation of full‑retimed and LRO‑based 1.6 Tb/s transceivers, delivering high performance, low power consumption, and high reliability.
